sort_phase.comparison: ascending by unsigned (first qword, second qword)

sort_phase.median: median of (first+1, middle, last-1) moved to first; middle is first + (count/2) elements; partition is a Hoare scan from first+1 and last-1; the right part is recursed on with depth-1 and the left part is looped on
